items.text: Emigisa enyakutungwa abahulizi
“Obworaahurraga MUKAMA Ruhanga wawe, n'oyekamba kukwata ebiragiro bye byona ebindukukuragira kiro kya hati, alikunyumiza akukize amahanga goona ag'omunsi.
Kandi obworaamuhurraga, oliheebwa emigisa enu yoona.
Oliheebwa omugisa omurubuga, oheebwe omugisa omumusiri.
Abaana bawe baliheebwa omugisa, n'ebijuma ebyolirima, ebyana eby'ebisoro byawe, ente zawe zirikanya n'entaama zaawe zirizaarwa muno.
MUKAMA Aliha omugisa engano yaawe, n'ebyokulya ebi ogicumbamu.
Oraaheebwaga omugisa n'otaaha, oraahebwaga omugisa n'oturuka.
“Abanyanzigwa bawe abanyakukwimukirra, MUKAMA abaleetere kusingurwa n'orora oti; balikuseesira nibaleetwa omuhanda gumu, baitu okukwiruka balitoma emihanda musanju.
MUKAMA Ruhanga wawe, byona ebyoraakoraga, araabihaga omugisa, amaguli gawe aligaijuza engano; alikuha omugisa omunsi eyarukwija kukuha.
Obwolihurra MUKAMA Ruhanga wawe, okakora kyona eki aragira, nkooku yakunihiize alikufoora ihanga lye mali nkooku yakunihiize.
Obu, amahanga goona ag'ensi, nubwo galirora MUKAMA nkooku yakukomere kuba muntu we, kandi nukwo gakutiine.
Omunsi egi MUKAMA ei yanihiize baaswenkuru ngu aligikuha, alikuheerayo ebirungi bingi muno; olizaara abaana baingi, ente zawe irizaara muno, kandi olyeeza ebyokulya bingi.
Alikukingurra eryahurro lye, niryo iguru, anage enjura omunsi yawe omukasumi kaayo, ahe omugisa byona ebi oraakoraga; oholege amahanga maingi, baitu iwe otalyohoza.
Kakuba okwata ebiragiro bya MUKAMA Ruhanga wawe ebindikukuragira hati, okataho omutima kubihikiriza,
oligumya ebigambo ebindikukugambira kiro kya hati, okanga kuserra embandwa n'okwihereza, MUKAMA alikutwara omumaiso, talikugarra enyuma, oraikaraga n'otemba tolisirimuka.
Ebinyakuruga omu butahurra
“Baitu obwotalihurra MUKAMA Ruhanga wawe, okataho omutima okukwata ebiragiro bye byona n'ebigambo bye ebindukukuragira kiro kya hati, emikyeno erikuhikaho ekwetuumeho.
Olikyenwa omurubuga noomu musiri.
MUKAMA alikyena engano yawe, n'ebyokulya ebyogicumbamu.
Abaana bawe, n'ebijuma eby'itaka lyawe, bireme kukanya, ente zaawe n'amagana g'entaama bikeehe.
Obworaabaga n'oturuka kandi n'otaaha, oraakyenwaga.
“MUKAMA habw'ebibi byawe wakozire, alikukyeena, alikuburanganiza, akukingire emihanda omu byona ebyoyenda kukora, okuhika obwolikahwerekerra okahwaho bwango.
Alikwikazaaho edwara, okuhika obwalikakumara omunsi eyoli haihi kutaahamu okagyetungira.
Alikwisa akakonko, omuswija, obuzimba, ekiirro, ekyanda, ekiyaga ihunga n'oruhumbo; ebi byona birikubonesa okuhika obu olikahwerekerra.
Iguru eryoraramira, lirifooka mulinga, kandi ensi eyorubataho, erifooka kyoma.
Omukiikaro eky'okunaga enjura omunsi yawe, alisesamu ecuucu n'omusenyi; ebi biriruga omwiguru bikusesekere, okuhika obwolihwerekerra.
“MUKAMA alikulekera abanyanzigwa bawe bakusingule; kubaseesira, olitwarwa omuhanda gumu, baitu kubairuka, olitwarwa emihanda musanju; olitiinisa amakama goona ag'ensi.
Omutumbi gwawe guliboijwa amanyonyi ag'omumwanya, kandi guliibwe enyamaiswa ez'omunsi; tihalibaho muntu noomu ow'alibibinga.
MUKAMA n'aija kukwisa ebizimba nkeebi yarwaize Abanyamisiri, ebihoya, omuhago, okuliibwa, ebyotalitambirwa.
Alikunaga iraro, akwite amaiso, akubuze ebiteekerezo;
omubwire bwa nyamusana, oraahumahumaga nka kihimbaara. Byona ebyoraakoraga, tobitungiremuga mugisa; oraabonabonesibwaga, kandi oraikaraga n'onyagwa, tihalibaho muntu noomu ow'okukukonyera.
Obwolijumbira omukazi, omusaija ondi nuwe alimuswera; obwolyombeka enju toligiraaramu; obwolirima omusiri gw'emizaabbibbu, ebijuma byagwo tolibibonaho.
Ente yawe baligikwitira omumaiso, baitu toligiryaho. Enkaina yawe erinyagwa norora oti, kandi terikugarulirwa; entaama zaawe ziriheebwa abanyanzigwa bawe, tihalibaho muntu noomu ow'okukukonyera.
Batabani bawe na bahara bawe, baliheebwa abantu abandi, na iwe oroleerire oti; izooba lyona, oraikaraga ohangire amaiso, obategeriize kugaruka.
Ihanga eryotakamanyahoga, niryo lirirya ebyokulya ebiwalimire haitaka lyawe n'ebintu ebindi ebi watalibaniire; baitu iwe, oraikaraga nobonabonesibwa, kandi n'okorwa kubi;
ebintu ebyolirora n'amaiso gawe, nukwo bikunage iraro.
MUKAMA naija kukurwaza ebizimba ebirukucumita ebyotasobora kutambirwa okuruga ha mara g'ekigere okuhika ha kasoke.
“MUKAMA alikutwara hamu n'omukama ou wayekomiire omu ihanga, iwe na baaswenkuru erimutakamanyahoga; oku nuho oliheerereza embandwa ezinyakukozirwe omumiti noomu mabaale.
Abantu barakwekangaga, ocwibwemuga orufumo, omu mahanga goona MUKAMA nambere alikutwara, oliba kintu eky'okugaywa.
Oraasigaga bingi, baitu oraagesaga bike; habwokuba biraamarwahoga enzige.
Olibyara kandi olime kurungi omusiri gw'emizabbibbu, oginogorre; baitu tolinywa marwa gaagwo, kandi tolinoga mizabbibbu yagwo.
Omunsi yawe yoona, habwokuba, erimarwaho enzito, olibyaramu emiti eya oliva, baitu amagita gaayo toligeesiiga, habwokuba ebijuma biriragara.
Olizaara aboojo n'abaisiki, baitu tibaliba bawe; habwokuba balinyagwa.
Emiti yawe yoona n'ebijuma eby'itaka lyawe, biririibwa enzige.
Abanyamahanga abanyakubaikaramu balyeyongera kuba bamaani, kandi inywe mulifuberra.
Nubo barabahoraga, inywe timulibahora; nubo baliba mutwe inywe muliba mukira kwonka,
okuhika obumulikahwerekerra. Emikyeno egi yoona, eribahikaho, eribakuraatira, eribakwata habwokuba mutahurre MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu, mutakwate ebiragiro bye n'ebigambo bye ebiyabaragiire.
Niyo eriba bwakaiso bw'omusango Ruhanga oguyabacweriire, inywe n'abaijukuru banyu, ebiro byona.
“Habwokuba, habw'okuburanganizibwa ebintu ebingi ebihinguraine mutaheereze MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu n'omuhimbo, n'omutima ogwina okusemererwa.

Habweki muliheereza abanyanzigwa banyu, MUKAMA abaalituma kubarwanisa, kunu nimurumwa enjara, nimwitwa iroho, mutaina byokujwara, ebintu byona bibahoireho; alibaboha omubikya ekikoligo eky'ekyoma, okuhika obwalibahwerekereza.
Alibaleetera ihanga, ery'okubarwanisa, aliihe hara ha mpero y'ensi erirukwanguha nk'isamba eri erirukuhurrukira omu mwanya, erimutarukukenga ngambo yalyo.
Ihanga eritaina mbabazi, eritatamu kitiinisa bantu bakuru, kandi eritagirra mbabazi abaana abato,

balirya enyama ey'ente zanyu n'ebijuma eby'itaka lyanyu, okuhika obumulikahwerekerra; ihanga eritalibalekera byokulya, eritalibalekera eviini rundi amagita, eririkeehya ente zanyu n'ebyana eby'amagana ganyu ag'entaama n'ag'embuzi, okuhika obubalibahwerekereza.

Balibagotera omumbuga zanyu zoona, okuhika ebiisiika byanyu ebiraihire kandi ebigumire ebimurukwesiga, obubirigwa omunsi yanyu yoona; kandi balibagota omumbuga zanyu zoona ez'omunsi, MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu eyarukwija kubaha.
Habw'emihito ei mulibamu, abanyanzigwa banyu obubaliba babagosire, mulirya abaijukuru banyu, mulirya batabani banyu na bahara banyu, MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu abayabahaire.
Omusaija ow'embabazi omuli inywe kandi ayayoroirwe kurungi, taliha owanyina ebyokulya, talibiha mukazi we, noobwakubaire omwana we macura anyakuli na uwe.
Abo boona, talibahaho nyama ey'abaana be abaarukulya; habwokuba habw'emihito nyingi ei muliba nayo, abanyanzigwa banyu obubalibafunza omumbuga zanyu, aliba atasigaize kantu.
2 Bakam 6:28
Emp 4:10
Omukazi omworobi kandi ayayoroirwe kurungi, atasobora kurubata haitaka, ngu habwokuba murungi, taliha iba ebyokulya, nabwakubaire mutabani we rundi muhara we;

abanyanzigwa obubalimufundiza omurubuga rw'owabu, alibulirwa kimu ebyokulya. Ekirirugamu, alye omwana we ou yakaruga kuzaara, hamu n'ekyenyuma, ebi, talibihaho iba ou agonza muno, rundi abamu ha baana be.
“Obumutalitaho omutima okuhikiriza ebiragiro byona ebinyakuhandiikirwe omukitabu kinu, mukatiina MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu ogu ow'ekitiinisa, kandi anyakutiinisa,
alibabonesa kandi alibonesa baijukuru banyu emihiito eyamaani etakarorwaga, kandi etalihwaho, alibarwaza endwara ez'amaani kandi ezitarukukira.
Aligaruka abarwaze endwara nk'ezimwarwaraga muli Misiri, ezimwatiinire; endwara ezi timulizikira.
Kandi buli ndwara na buli muhito ogutaahandiikirwe omukitabu eky'ebiragiro binu, ebi byona MUKAMA alibibahikyaho, okuhika obumulihwerekerra.
Inywe abakaba bali baingi nk'enyunyuuzi eza haiguru, mulisigara muli mbarwa; habwokuba mutahurre MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu.
MUKAMA nkooku yasemeriirwe kubakorra ebirungi n'okubakanyisa, kandi nukwo alisemererwa kubahweerekereza, n'okubamaraho; mulimeenywa muruge omunsi ei murukugenda kulya.

MUKAMA alibararangya omu mahanga goona, okuruga harubaju orumu orw'ensi, okuhika ha rundi; oku nuho muliheerereza embandwa ezakozirwe omumiti n'omumabaale, inywe na baisenkuru inywe abamutaramanyireho.
Omu mahanga ago, timulitungirayo businge, timulibona hookuta kigere. MUKAMA alibaheerayo omutima ogw'enkizi, alibaleetera okutahweza kurungi, n'omwoyo omuceke;
muraikaraga muharaize emitima; nimutiina obukiire n'obwizire; obwomeezi bwanyu bwona, timuligwagwana.

Omu bwire bwa nyenkya, muraagambaga muti: ‘Haa boojo, bubaire kwira!’ Kandi omukairirizi, muraagambaga muti: ‘Haa boojo, bubaire kukya!’ Eki kiraaletwaga obutiini obunyakubali omumutima, noomu bintu ebimuraaroraga.

MUKAMA alibatwaarra omumeeri, abagarre omunsi Misiri, abarabye omuruguudo ruli, orunabagambiire nti: ‘Oruguudo oru, timuligaruka kururora; oku nuho mulyeherayo hali abanyanzigwa banyu mugurwe, mube bairu n'abazaana, baitu busaho noomu alibagura.’”
